newsitem.title: UK: NatWest Markets buys corporate finance firm.
newsitem.headline: NatWest Markets buys corporate finance firm.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank Plc, said on Thursday it has agreed to buy corporate finance specialist J O Hambro Magan & Co for an unspecified sum.
Hambro Magan was one of the few major independent corporate finance specialists and has advised on 18 billion stg of transactions since its founding in 1988, NatWest said in a statement.

NatWest said Hambro Magan will combine with NatWest Markets Corporate Finance in the UK and Gleacher NatWest in the U.S. as well as NatWest's corporate advisory groups in Asia and the emerging markets.
Hambro Magan employs 40 people and was ranked 15th for advising on UK public and private transactions in 1995 with deals valued at 4.45 billion stg.
It was ranked 7th for European cross-border deals last year with 5.8 billion stg.
Hambro Magan chairman George Magan will become chairman of NatWest's UK and European corporate advisory business. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8864
